enum.name: project
enum.description: A project entity, used to organize and manage related data, code, and resources.

enum.name: folder
enum.description: A folder entity, used to group and organize entities within a project.

enum.name: file
enum.description: A file entity, representing a file stored in Synapse.

enum.name: table
enum.description: A table entity, representing tabular data in Synapse.

enum.name: link
enum.description: A link entity, used to reference another entity in Synapse.

enum.name: entityview
enum.description: An entity view, providing a filtered or customized view of entities.

enum.name: dockerrepo
enum.description: A Docker repository entity, used to store Docker images.

enum.name: submissionview
enum.description: Type for entities that define evaluation submission views

enum.name: dataset
enum.description: A dataset is a view of a list of entities.

enum.name: datasetcollection
enum.description: A dataset collection is a view of a list of datasets.

enum.name: materializedview
enum.description: A materialized view is a view whose content is defined by a Synapse SQL query and it is persisted as a synapse table.

enum.name: virtualtable
enum.description: A virtual table is represents the results of Synapse SQL query. The results are not persisted and the query is run each time the virtual table is queried.

enum.name: recordset
enum.description: A special type of file that captures record-based metadata as a special type of CSV.

enum.name: searchindex
enum.description: A search index entity that provides search over Synapse data via OpenSearch.
